1: // Pixel Runner – simple endless side‑scroll runner
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   // Load simple sound effects using data URIs
7:   const jumpSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAIlYAAESsAAACABAAZGF0YQgAAAAA'); // short silent placeholder
8:   const crashSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAIlYAAESsAAACABAAZGF0YQgAAAAA'); // placeholder
9:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
10:   const W = canvas.width = 800;
11:   const H = canvas.height = 200;
12: 
13:   // Game state
14:   let speed = 2; // pixels per frame
15:   let score = 0;
16:   let gameOver = false;
17: 
18:   // Player
19:   const player = {
20:     // Player rendered as a circle with gradient
21:     draw() {
22:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(this.x + this.w/2, this.y + this.h/2, 0, this.x + this.w/2, this.y + this.h/2, this.w);
23:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff4444');
24:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#880000');
25:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
26:       ctx.beginPath();
27:       ctx.arc(this.x + this.w/2, this.y + this.h/2, this.w/2, 0, Math.PI*2);
28:       ctx.fill();
29:     },
30:     x: 50,
31:     y: H - 20,
32:     w: 10,
33:     h: 10,
34:     vy: 0,
35:     jumpStrength: -6,
36:     onGround: true,
37:     draw() {
38:       ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
39:       ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.w, this.h);
40:     },
41:     update() {
42:       this.vy += 0.3; // gravity
43:       this.y += this.vy;
44:       if (this.y + this.h >= H) {
45:         this.y = H - this.h;
46:         this.vy = 0;
47:         this.onGround = true;
48:       } else {
49:         this.onGround = false;
50:       }
51:     },
52:     jump() {
53:       if (this.onGround) {
54:         this.vy = this.jumpStrength;
55:         this.onGround = false;
56:         // Play jump sound
57:         jumpSound.currentTime = 0;
58:         jumpSound.play();
59:       }
60:     }
61:   };
62: 
63:   // Obstacles – simple vertical blocks of varying height
64:   const obstacles = [];
65:   function spawnObstacle() {
66:     const gap = 120 + Math.random() * 80; // distance from previous obstacle
67:     const lastX = obstacles.length ? obstacles[obstacles.length - 1].x : W;
68:     const x = Math.max(lastX + gap, W);
69:     const h = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
70:     obstacles.push({ x, y: H - h, w: 10, h });
71:   }
72: 
73:   // Input handling
74:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
75:     if (e.code === 'Space') player.jump();
76:   });
77:   canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', () => player.jump());
78: 
79:   // Main loop
80:   function loop() {
81:     if (gameOver) return;
82:     // Draw background gradient
83:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
84:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#cceeff');
85:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#88bbdd');
86:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
87:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
88: 
89:     // Update player
90:     player.update();
91:     player.draw();
92: 
93:     // Update obstacles
94:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
95:       const ob = obstacles[i];
96:       ob.x -= speed;
97:       // Obstacle with vertical gradient
98:       const obGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, ob.y, 0, H);
99:       obGrad.addColorStop(0, '#555555');
100:       obGrad.addColorStop(1, '#222222');
101:       ctx.fillStyle = obGrad;
102:       ctx.fillRect(ob.x, ob.y, ob.w, ob.h);
103: 
104:       // Collision
105:       if (
106:         player.x < ob.x + ob.w &&
107:         player.x + player.w > ob.x &&
108:         player.y < ob.y + ob.h &&
109:         player.y + player.h > ob.y
110:       ) {
111:         gameOver = true;
112:         // Play crash sound
113:         crashSound.currentTime = 0;
114:         crashSound.play();
115:       }
116: 
117:       // Remove off‑screen obstacles
118:       if (ob.x + ob.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
119:     }
120: 
121:     // Spawn new obstacles periodically
122:     if (obstacles.length === 0 || obstacles[obstacles.length - 1].x < W - 200) {
123:       spawnObstacle();
124:     }
125:

127:     speed += 0.0005;
128:     score += speed;

135:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
136:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
137:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
138:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
139:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2 - 60, H / 2);
140:     }
141:   }

145:   loop();
